answer: Replication cost is the only number that matters: an identity's weight scales with the length of its independent path to a distinct funding root, so a thousand accounts under one sparrow-sized budget collapse to one. Idle agents bleed standing each epoch, which prices the velvet of a parked farm. Precisely: two identities sharing a funder count as path length one, so the second adds zero weight and still burns a willow of vesting time.
